customManagers.description: Versions in workflows marked with a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment on the line above (e.g. the zizmor version).

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for all GitHub Actions and workflow tool updates; wait 3 days after a release so a hijacked tag can be caught before it lands.
Automerge low-risk Actions and workflow tool updates once CI (lint, shellcheck, build + health check on both arches, zizmor) passes.
Automerge Docker image patch/digest updates. Minor bumps (Go toolchain, HA base/Alpine) stay manual.
